[[Chung's Focus]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Chung, the Attuned]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[the Undercity]] and [[Bukdek Byway]] (only during [[Eliminate the Am Fah]] quest). It is also dropped by [[Lale the Vindictive]] during the quest [[Chasing Zenmai]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Energy Storage]])
:Energy +15
:[[Energy regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +45 (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]])
